recentItems.title: Golden Axe | Full Episode (S1, E2) | ”Rideable Beasts” | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
"Rideable Beasts" - When Gilius (Matthew Rhys) and Hampton (Danny Pudi) shop for a rideable beast, Hampton chooses the most pathetic creature for himself and frees the rest. Meanwhile, Ax (Liam McIntyre) and Tyris (Lisa Gilroy) are embarrassed by their new teammate’s magical abilities. Worried about their image, they ask him to not use magic but in the conversation Ax and Tyris end up in an argument of their own.

recentItems.description:
"The Legend of the Emerald Blade" - Feeling unappreciated, battle-dwarf Gilius Thunderhead (Matthew Rhys) separates from his companions Ax (Liam McIntyre) and Tyris (Lisa Gilroy) and sets off in search of the legendary Emerald Blade. Along the way, he meets the inexperienced and overeager Hampton Squib (Danny Pudi). Meanwhile, Ax and Tyris replace Gilius with half-panther, half-man Chronos Lait (Carl Tart).
